notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard regional DDM boundary behavior. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador API and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback model, and application configuration. It verifies zero-dimensional and partial-region lifecycle behavior, incompatible region-context rejection, foreign-region ownership boundaries, region-in-use cleanup, and the corresponding standard failures without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador region lifecycle and region-qualified object and interaction services with standard boundary exceptions
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador region, object-management, interaction, and DDM declarations
